text:
lucy: quick question
trying to make the JS SDK work in Deno + Bun edge environments. hitting import resolution and crypto issues. anyone handled this recently?

hiro: which import errors?

lucy: Deno complains about bare specifier @redwood/sdk even though I have import_map.json mapping it to ./dist/mod.mjs. it still prefers package.json exports and fails.

adrian: Deno won't use package.json exports for bare imports. import_map must map the bare name to a relative or URL path. example: { "imports": { "@redwood/sdk": "./dist/mod.mjs" } } then run with --import-map=import_map.json. ensure dist/mod.mjs is ESM.

lucy: thanks. bun: complains globalThis.crypto.subtle is undefined when we try to do HMAC for auth.

hiro: polyfill or fallback. easiest: detect globalThis.crypto?.subtle and if missing use a tiny pure-js fallback (tweetnacl or tiny-crypto) for digest. keep it behind a single conditional so bundlers can tree-shake.

adrian: also watch timers. setTimeout in Workers/Bun isn9t identical to Node timers; replace backoff with await sleep(ms) => new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)). avoids clearTimeout type mismatches.

lucy: TS typing problems too when publishing CJS+ESM: consumers get missing d.ts for ESM entry. how to signal types in package.json?

hiro: add "types": "dist/index.d.ts" at root, and in exports provide a types entry: "./": { "import":"./dist/mod.mjs", "require":"./dist/mod.cjs", "types":"./dist/index.d.ts" }. TS will pick up. also publish a top-level mod.ts for Deno users to import via URL.

adrian: one more edge gotcha: background refresh timers for auth tokens. workers cold-starts lose timers. make refresh lazy on first request + singleflight so concurrent requests share the refresh promise. fallback to old token if refresh fails but still valid for a short window.

ci-bot: note created: please add a small deno example under examples/deno-quickstart and a bun-edge sample demonstrating fetch+retry.

omar: I'll draft mod.ts and crypto fallback helper, assign to lucy for review. lucy: will open PR later today. thanks folks :)
